slides.body: No yoga guarantees wealth, and no planet predicts a market. This is behavioural awareness, not financial advice or a stock pick.
Venus (Shukra) stands for comfort, beauty and pleasure. As a bias: income rises, spending rises with it, and the plan slips.
Lifestyle inflation comes from adaptation: new comforts soon feel normal, so the bar keeps rising.
The 2nd house is what you keep and the 11th is what you gain. A Venus strongly tied to the 2nd may value comfort. Read it with the whole chart, never alone.
This is a bias check, not a tip. Consult a licensed advisor for real decisions.
Free Venus Placement Check: see how you think about comfort and money.
